name: Path Feature
summary: Outcast Path Feature Ranger Your Death from Elsewhere feature recharges when you roll initiative if you have no uses remaining. Corsair After scoring a critical hit, you may make one pistol or blade attack as a bonus action. Shadow Guide Once per short rest, you and up to two allies within 30 ft may move 10 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.
